title: 4 Day Workout Split
author: Cynthia R.
desc: Created this program for myself with exercises I like. Feel free to replace whatever you need with exercises that still work the same muscles. Make sure to focus on slow and controlled movements. No ego lifting, focus on perfecting your form. Once form is good you can work on progressive overload.

ex.note: It’s 10 reps per leg, so 20 total
Slow and controlled, hold for 1 second at the top of each rep. This is a burnout, don’t need to go too heavy
Can do with dumbbells, kettlebells, barbell, Smith Machine, or body weight
Really engage your core, you will be engaging your stabilizing muscles here.
My gym has no barbells but if yours does you can use a barbell or dumbbells instead
This is in between a skullcrusher and close grip bench press. It’s a Tricep exercise not a chest exercise. Make sure to watch plenty of videos to get the form right
